services.name: Go-Karts
services.desc: Race Indy style go-karts on the premier go-kart track in southwestern Michigan. Hug the curves close to the rail so you don’t get passed. If kids are under 10 years of age and under 54″ tall they can ride our double seat cars free with an adult. And, kids, have fun because the double seat cars go as fast as the single-seaters!DOUBLE SEAT GO-KART: Passenger under 54" tall MUST ride with adult.Price: $8.00 Jr. Go-Karts: The perfect track for 5-10 year olds to practice for the big track. The 200-foot track goes over a bridge and through a tunnel for an exciting ride. blurb: Guests can play 18 holes of mini golf featuring ponds, streams, and a 30' lighthouse. They can enjoy bumper boats with water cannons and water balloon battles. The park also offers batting cages with pitching machines, go-kart racing on a premier track, and a game room with skeeball and redemption games.
